### Expected Behavior

I expected ComfyUI to save the changes I make to a workflow and not overwrite the workflow with the previous unedited version (prior to the changes) or with the contents of a completely different workflow opened in another ComfyUI tab.

### Actual Behavior

Many, many and I mean many times when I edit a workflow I have opened it will not save the changes, it will save the previous version before any edits were made.
It also has the habit after editing a workflow and if any other workflow is open in another tab, the edited workflow on save becomes the workflow from the other opened workflow.
